retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast live performance scene featuring warm stage lighting and heavy diagonal block typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic live music scene captured with high-contrast lighting, featuring performers in warm-toned attire against a dark background, anchored by heavy, diagonally-oriented block lettering in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm orange stage light against deep black shadows
Diagonal text orientation mirroring the stage perspective
Repetition of performers creating depth and rhythm
High-contrast silhouettes defined by rim lighting
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif typography with a distinct outline
Warm orange and red color dominance in the subject
Deep black negative space in the lower left and background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Performers are positioned on the right half, scaled to full height, receding into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright orange diagonal text in the top left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal text downward to the lead performer, then follows the line of backing singers into the depth of the stage.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space in the bottom left and top right corners creates focus on the subjects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and red stage lighting and costumes
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan or light blue outlines on the typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones against zero-value blacks.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face used for all primary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and blunt terminals.
Provides the geometric slab feel characteristic of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a soul band performing on a dark stage, lit by warm orange spotlights creating rim light on red jumpsuits, with deep black shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of heavy slab-serif text in the top left corner, rotated 30 degrees upwards, filled with orange and outlined in thin cyan.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with warm highlights?
Does the typography have a thin cyan outline?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the orange stage glow
Number of performers in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the performers

mustAchieve: Warm/Cool color contrast between fill and outline

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is uppercase and slab-serif.
Ensure the orange glow feels like stage lighting.
Verify the diagonal alignment of the text block.
Confirm the presence of the cyan outline on the letters.
recipe.reuseFormula: Stage lighting + Diagonal Slab Serif + High Contrast Shadows
